properties.statement: The canonical unit spelling is idempotent: spelling a canonical spelling again changes nothing.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ s : String, Esm.Units.canon (Esm.Units.canon s) = Esm.Units.canon s

properties.statement: A unit string that resolves has a canonical spelling that resolves to the same unit (same dimension and exact scale).
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (s : String) (u : Esm.Units.U), Esm.Units.resolve s = .ok u → ∃ u', Esm.Units.resolve (Esm.Units.canon s) = .ok u' ∧ u'.Agree u

properties.statement: A unit string whose canonical spelling resolves resolves itself, to the same unit: canonicalization never makes a non-resolving string resolve.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (s : String) (u' : Esm.Units.U), Esm.Units.resolve (Esm.Units.canon s) = .ok u' → ∃ u, Esm.Units.resolve s = .ok u ∧ u'.Agree u

properties.statement: Two unit strings that parse to the same two-sided normal form (the same symbols with the same summed exponents on each side of the fraction bar) have the same canonical spelling.
properties.lean_statement: ∀ (s t : String) (e e' : Esm.Units.UExpr), Esm.Units.parseChars s.toList = .ok e → Esm.Units.parseChars t.toList = .ok e' → Esm.Units.norm2 e.factors = Esm.Units.norm2 e'.factors → (Esm.Units.norm2 e.factors).all (fun f => Esm.Units.symOK f.1) = true → Esm.Units.keepsSyms e = true → Esm.Units.keepsSyms e' = true → Esm.Units.canon s = Esm.Units.canon t
